windows-terminal/ is copied unmodified from that commit's windowsterminal/
directory. Chameleon reads these files at startup (src/palette/scheme-library.ts)
and never fetches them at runtime. To update, vendor a newer pinned commit and
update the SHA above — do not hand-edit the JSON.
